title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 9: Saul searches for his father's lost donkeys and meets Samuel the seer.

questions.text: What was the name of Saul's father?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 9:1-2 says Kish, a man of Benjamin, had a son whose name was Saul.

questions.text: What was said about Saul's height?
questions.explanation: From his shoulders and upward Saul was taller than any of the people.

answers.text: He was the shortest of his brothers
He was of average height for a Benjamite
He was taller than anyone from his shoulders upward
He was smaller than the servant with him

questions.text: What had Kish lost, so that he sent Saul to look for them?
questions.explanation: The donkeys of Kish, Saul's father, were lost, and Kish sent Saul with a servant to look for them.

questions.text: In which land did Saul suggest that they return home?
questions.explanation: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to his servant, "Come! Let's return."

questions.text: What did the servant have to give to the man of God?
questions.explanation: The servant said he had in his hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver.

answers.text: Ten loaves of bread from his sack
The fourth part of a shekel of silver
A young goat from Kish's flock
A golden ring from his finger

questions.text: What was a prophet called in earlier times in Israel?
questions.explanation: He who is now called a prophet was before called a seer.

questions.text: Whom did Saul and his servant meet going up the ascent to the city?
questions.explanation: They found young maidens going out to draw water and asked them, "Is the seer here?"

answers.text: Priests going to the high place
Young maidens going out to draw water

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Samuel he should do with the man from the land of Benjamin?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "You shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel."

answers.text: Send him back to his father
Make him a priest at the high place
Anoint him to be prince over Israel
Give him his daughter as wife

questions.text: How did Saul describe his tribe?
questions.explanation: Saul said he was a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel.

answers.text: The smallest of the tribes of Israel
The largest of the tribes of Israel

questions.text: What did the cook set before Saul?
questions.explanation: The cook took up the thigh and that which was on it and set it before Saul.

answers.text: A whole roasted lamb with bread
The thigh and what was on it
Fish and a cup of wine
